rules.text: the tense class of the immediately following token and the adjacency of the particle to it are SUPPLIED evidence; the reading is selected locally and never carried over from another occurrence
the two tense environments produce opposite modal force, so a fixed rendering is prohibited: no reading is emitted before the tense class of the following token is supplied
the secondary readings sit alongside the primary ones rather than replacing them; where the contextual condition is supplied, primary and secondary are preserved together
the particle governs nothing: no mood or case consequence is ever emitted from any reading of this table
a non-verbal token immediately after the particle means the analysis or the identification of the particle is wrong; that is an abstention and a review flag, never a reading
